title: What the checker prepares reaches the member as a leading constant of the call, and it is a fact rather than an object
scope:
the channel from `nvs-types`' intrinsic pass to the running member — where a prepared
answer is filed, how it is addressed, what it may be, and which members take one. It does not decide
what any grammar prepares; a row's own answer is [ADR 0057](0057.md)'s.
dependsOnText:
[0057](0057.md) (the intrinsic roster and preparation), [0063](0063.md) (a call's
arguments are addressed by parameter), [0018](0018.md) (the artifact's identity).
